query: Based on the conversations, what is each visibly-engaged group member's stance on spice levels in the reunion food, and how clearly do they signal it?
gold: The family is split clearly into spice tiers and several members make their stance visible during the heat-tier debate. Uncle Bayo is at the same end but more pragmatic: he proposes the heat-tier system ('mild, medium, hot. one pot each'), and later confirms 'i need some heat in mine' and 'spicy stays in my pot.' Tobi opts out of the spice conversation entirely ('low key i'll prob skip the spice wars convo, but yeah heat tiers fine'). The remaining members (Tunde, Femi, Yemi, Ronke, the cousins outside Maris) do not stake spice positions. The visible spectrum runs Kemi/Bayo (high heat) -> Maris (low-sodium adjacent) -> Ada (none, due to pregnancy), with Bisi and Tobi preferring meatless/neutral.
